name: shrek-2-remastered-aspyr-voices-switch-2-4k
spoken: أصوات 2004 لم تتغير في Shrek 2 Remastered، قالها منتجا اللعبة في أسباير (Aspyr). وقالت أسباير لموقع نينتيندو إفريثينغ إن اللعبة تعمل بدقة 4K مع 60 إطارًا على Switch 2 في وضع التلفاز. ولا جديد بعد عن ألعاب Shrek الأخرى.

angle.hook: the voices players remember from 2004 are untouched in Shrek 2 Remastered
angle.why_now: Aspyr's producers said it in an interview Nintendo Everything published on 15 Nov 2026, five days after launch
angle.what_it_means_here: players in the region who grew up on the 2004 game hear the same voices, and Switch 2 owners get 4K at 60 fps on the TV
angle.payoff: no word yet on other Shrek games returning; the whole gang in one closing picture

story_type_items.INTERVIEW: who: Aspyr's senior game producer Jeff Carmen (plate from 0 s) and associate producer Conner Allen (both named in the caption); where: Nintendo Everything (card label «أسباير لموقع نينتيندو إفريثينغ», X, Threads, caption, pinned comment); tidbits: the 2004 voice work kept 1:1 (headline), 4K and 60 fps docked on Switch 2 (card), nothing to share on other Shrek remasters (L2)

3.15 to 6.6 L1 «قالها منتجا اللعبة / في أسباير (Aspyr)»: Shrek walking to camera (announce 38.9), Shrek in the potion shop, framed at 0.65 and cut at 28.55 before he leaves the frame (launch 26.55)
